experiment.hypothesis: Routing new non-founder GURU through an Operational Teacher onboarding that creates the first class, shares the access code, and guides >=1 artifact + >=3 student activations in ~10 minutes raises class-creation (activation) rate from 11.2% toward >=25% for new-teacher cohorts and yields first-ever Operational Classrooms.
experiment.gridGoal: Activation and Operational Classrooms kept as SEPARATE tracked metrics; never collapsed.

operationalClassroomDefinition.X: Teacher shipped >=1 artifact (Penugasan, QuizAssignment, MateriKirim, Pengumuman, or >=1 StudentKarya into the group) in trailing-30d
operationalClassroomDefinition.Y: >=3 distinct active students in the group (distinct userId in GroupMember with Z evidence)
operationalClassroomDefinition.Z: Student activity evidence in trailing-30d via ANY of: XPTransaction, QuizSubmission, UserUnitProgress, ProgresKompetensi, StudentKarya
operationalClassroomDefinition.compositeRule: Operational Classrooms (30d) = Group where X AND Y AND Z over the same trailing-30d window
operationalClassroomDefinition.baselineNote: Uncomputed today (no Operational Classroom calc exists).
